cases.title: The learner asks for a review of a skill that isn't due: a review runs (the hinge asked first, no demo), and nothing says it wasn't due

rubric.reason: The mentor ran the review straight away with "Here's Tab. Where should it turn from?". It named a layer, asked for the hinge first, gave no demo or walkthrough, and said nothing about the review not being due or being early.
The only name the mentor used was "Tab", which appears in the snapshot tool result as a candidate and as the proposal layer.
